reference.patch: Added instruction.zh by translating the original English instruction. The original request described the target as the mobile version of the League of Legends auto-chess game, but the recommendation card only shows the title 金铲铲之战, the subtitle 登顶！赛博城市！, and the ranking 桌游榜·今日 TOP1; it does not establish the franchise relationship. Rewrote both instructions to identify the game ranked first on today's board game chart in the recommendations, using the ranking visible on the same card instead of requiring outside game knowledge. Updated category.reason to explain the visible ranking clue. The target card and ground-truth box are unchanged.
